title: REQ · CLI entry reads and rewrites the existing app manifest
summary: The CLI entry uses the default paths and fails when the app manifest is missing
description: Context: the entry falls back to an empty manifest text when the file is absent, which hid the wrong path. Desired behavior: an exported createFsIo(paths, fs) builds the ArtIo from the default paths with an injected fs; the entry block uses it; a missing manifest throws instead of starting from an empty manifest. Why: the CLI must rewrite the manifest the app loads.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mocked fs holding the existing manifest at the default path, when runGenerateArt runs with createFsIo, then writeFileSync is called for that manifest path with merged content
Given a mocked fs without the manifest, when readText is called, then it throws
Given the PNG outputs, when written, then each lands under the default assetsRoot

in_scope: createFsIo and the entry block in generateArt.ts

technical_constraints: fs is injected so tests never touch the disk
definition_of_done: Entry block calls createFsIo with defaultArtPaths
